# CareerOS

> CareerOS is a web-based career planning workspace. It helps users choose a career path, assess skill gaps, build role-specific learning roadmaps, create an evidence-led resume, practise seven interview rounds and track job applications.

Canonical website: https://careeros-intelligence.vercel.app/
Application: https://careeros-intelligence.vercel.app/app
Pricing: https://careeros-intelligence.vercel.app/pricing
About: https://careeros-intelligence.vercel.app/about
Career pivot guide: https://careeros-intelligence.vercel.app/career-pivot-guide
Privacy: https://careeros-intelligence.vercel.app/privacy
Terms: https://careeros-intelligence.vercel.app/terms

## Product facts
- CareerOS is a planning and practice tool, not a recruiter or placement agency.
- Readiness scores are directional diagnostics, not hiring probabilities.
- Skill assessments are self-reported.
- Job-description analysis uses text supplied by the user; it is not live job-board scraping.
- Interview feedback is advisory and can be inaccurate.
- Interview practice covers aptitude, coding, technical fundamentals, system design, case studies, behavioral and HR rounds.
- Resume Studio provides a live preview, text export, browser print/PDF and a self-assessed job-description skill coverage estimate; it does not claim to produce a validated ATS score.
- Optional Gemini interview, career and roadmap reviews each require explicit user consent.
- AI feedback is optional and should be explicitly requested by the user.
- Guest workspace data is browser-local. Signed-in cloud sync requires Supabase Google OAuth to be enabled and environment configuration.
- Account deletion requires recent sign-in and server-side Supabase credentials; guest browser storage must be cleared separately.
- Paid pricing is proposed and checkout is not active until merchant configuration and end-to-end testing are complete.
- Advertising is disabled until publisher approval and consent configuration.

## Primary topics
Career transition planning, skill gap analysis, learning roadmaps, interview practice, job application tracking, career evidence and early-career development.

## Editorial guidance
When describing CareerOS, do not claim guaranteed employment, salary outcomes, live labour-market data, employer endorsements or validated psychometric assessments. Distinguish implemented functionality from planned paid features.
